acceptance_criteria.statement: build_claims sets iss to the app id, iat 60 s back and exp 540 s ahead.
A cached installation token is reused within its lifetime and re-minted after expiry.
A private key with mode 0644 is refused with app_key_permissions.
token_for returns the token without key material and refuses an unconfigured app with app_not_configured.
The reviewer key path is accepted at 0600 and refused at 0640.

observable_behavior: claims are short-lived and issued for the app
an insecurely permissioned key is refused
outcome.summary: Mint coordinator installation tokens from the app private key (short-lived JWT, cached until just before expiry), refuse a key readable by group/other, never return key material, and expose the reviewer key path only to the configured poster user.
